{{Update |title1=First-Time User Update |image1=Hackerthumbnail.png |release_date = 25 June 2025 (v1.68.0) |minor_updates = v1.68.0a (25 June 2025)
release/v1.68.1 (26 June 2025)
v1.68.2 (27 June 2025) |feed_title = 👶 First-Time User Update |feed_color = Orange |previous_update = [[v1.67.3]] |next_update = [[v1.69.0]] }} ==Description== '''v1.68.0''' is the one hundred and twentieth update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 25th of June 2025. It added small improvements to the game. This update encompassed three versions, the main '''v1.68.0''' update (released 25 June 2025) and three minor updates, v1.68.0a (released 25 June 2025), release/v1.68.1 update (released 26 June 2025) and v1.68.2 (released 27 June 2025). ==Changes & Bugfixes== *Updated tower costs. **[[Ace Pilot]] cost decreased from {{Coins|3,500}} to {{Coins|1,500}}. **[[Farm]] cost decreased from {{Coins|2,500}} to {{Coins|2,000}}. **[[Freezer]] cost decreased from {{Coins|1,600}} to {{Coins|500}}. **[[Hunter]] cost decreased from {{Coins|300}} to {{Coins|200}}. **[[Medic]] cost decreased from {{Coins|1,500}} to {{Coins|800}}. **[[Militant]] cost decreased from {{Coins|1,500}} to {{Coins|650}}. **[[Pyromancer]] cost decreased from {{Coins|3,500}} to {{Coins|1,250}}. **[[Shotgunner]] cost decreased from {{Coins|2,500}} to {{Coins|1,000}}. **[[Soldier]] cost decreased from {{Coins|400}} to {{Coins|350}}. *[[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode wave structure and dialogue changed. *[[Tutorial]] updated. **Wave structure changed. **Added audio for dialogue. **Re-added the lobby part of the [[Tutorial]]. **[[Demoman]] is now again bought in the lobby part of the [[Tutorial]] rather than given out. **Losing is now impossible by letting enemies get to the exit. **Health bar replaced with a progress bar. **Corrected certain timings. *Current wave now displays the total amount of waves. *Updated Ready button visuals. Players now can see who voted to be ready and remove their vote if they change their mind. *Added a button with an explanation in the upgrade menu on how double path towers work. *[[Skills]] are now locked to {{Level|15}}. *Updated [[Skills]] menu music. :In '''v1.68.0a''': *Fixed certain dialogue audio not playing. :In '''release/v1.68.1''': *Fixed ready and skip prompts displaying the total player count as being needed for them, when in reality it is lower by 1 in all match sizes except solo. :In '''v1.68.2''': *Version number changed from ''release/v1.68.1'' to ''v1.68.2''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} Hackerthumbnail.png {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} Hackergameicon.png {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} V1.43.0Render.png }} ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate, as this is transcribed from the in-game update log. Several things may be incorrect, and there may be things that are missing.'' ===v1.68.0=== {{UpdateLog| {{UpdateBanner|V1.43.0Render.png|👶 First-Time User Update}} {{UpdateH1|📜Update Log:}} {{UpdateH2|✅ Updated User Interface / UX}} {{UpdateWhiteText|Added new polished visuals for ready button!
You can now see whos{{sic}} voted for starting the game.
You can also un-ready if you change your mind.}} {{UpdateThumbnail|v1.68.0Log1.png|Updated more polished visuals for ready button.}} {{UpdateThumbnail|v1.68.0Log2.png|Updated gamemode cards with gamemode rewards.}} {{UpdateH2|🔥 Coming Soon 🔥}} {{UpdateWhiteText|🎆 4th of July Skin (Next Week!)
☀️ Summer Battlepass
🥊 PVP Gamemode
...keep an eye on our socials for more info!📢}} {{UpdateH1|🔨Game Changes:}} {{UpdateH3|Improvements}} *Updated [[Skills|skill tree]] music *Fixed a lot of timings for all the [[tutorial]] prompts to ensure they are not too fast or too slow. *You can now see the current wave number out of total waves in the wave counter *[[Skills|Skills]] are now locked level to level 15. {{UpdateH3|[[Tutorial]]}} *Added a brand new wave at the end to allow players to play around with their towers. *Added a custom prompt to start the [[Tutorial|tutorial]]. *Added voice lines for the commander for all dialog in the [[Tutorial|tutorial]]. *Updated the health-bar and color to show [[Tutorial|tutorial]] progress. *Spotlights now only let you press the button and not outside the button. *[[Demoman]] is now not awarded until you reach the lobby tutorial. *Lobby tutorial has now been re-enabled for new players. *Fixed the tower given UI to be bigger and more visible. {{UpdateH3|[[Fallen Mode|Fallen]]}} *[[Fallen Mode]] has been tweaked again based on community feedback to make it more challenging. *Wave structure has been tweaked across the early, mid, late game to make it more challenging. *Various [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] enemies have also had small adjustments {{UpdateH3|Tower Coin Prices}} *[[Ace Pilot]]: $3,500 -> $1,500 *[[Farm]] $2,500 -> $2,000 *[[Freezer]]: $1,600 -> $500 *[[Hunter]]: $300 -> $200 *[[Medic]]: $1,500 -> $800 *[[Militant]]: $1,500 -> $650 *[[Pyromancer]]: $3,500 -> $1,250 *[[Shotgunner]]: $2,500 -> $1,000 *[[Soldier]]: $400 -> $350 }} {{UpdateNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:v1.68.0}} [[Category:Modern Updates]]
